content_md:
## What Is Packify.ai?

Packify.ai is an AI-powered packaging design agent by PACDORA PTE. LTD. that converts text prompts into 3D packaging concepts with print-ready dielines. It offers AI Photoshoot label generator nutrition facts generator and API access for e-commerce workflows.

## Key Features for Print Shops and POD Sellers

### AI Packaging Design
Transform text into 3D packaging concepts in seconds. Generate product visuals from natural language prompts.

### Print-Ready Dielines
Quick templates for packaging that go from mockup to manufacturable dielines box bag pouch label and more.

### AI Photoshoot
Swap backgrounds instantly for product-photography-style renders without a physical photoshoot.

### Packify API
Integrate the generation engine into e-commerce workflows (Business and Enterprise plans).

## Pricing

| Plan | Monthly | Annual (per mo) | Credits/Mo |
|------|---------|-----------------|------------|
| Free | $0 | - | 100 one-time |
| Basic | $19.90 | $14.90 | 1000 |
| Pro | $29.90 | $19.90 | 2500 |
| Business | $49.90 | $29.90 | 3500 |
| Enterprise | $129.00 | $69.90 | 10000 |

## Value for Print Shops / POD Sellers

1. Describe your packaging need via text prompt
2. AI generates 3D packaging concepts in seconds
3. Refine with Smart Design Edit on dieline layers
4. Generate AI Photoshoot images for product listings
5. Export print-ready dielines for manufacturing

## Verdict

Use it if: You need AI-powered packaging design with print-ready output. Best for print shops adding packaging services.

Skip it if: You only need basic product mockups (not packaging) or have a tight budget under $20/mo.

faqs.a: Packify.ai offers a Free tier with 100 one-time credits to explore features. Active use requires a paid plan starting at $19.90/month.

faqs.q: Does Packify.ai have an affiliate program?
faqs.a: No public affiliate program exists. A referral link is in the footer but has no published commission structure.
Yes. Packify.ai generates print-ready dielines compatible with standard packaging manufacturing.
